text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, listen!
Yesterday's livestream was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I introduced some famous spots in Tomakomai, and someone even
booked a ferry ticket right during the stream...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If I work hard on promotion, its charm will shine through.
I just have to become even more well-known!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed Hokko Tarumae was able to have a fun day off.
